 38. Fifth branch of contention canvassed from side of petitioners is that Appellate Judge did not at all reverse findings arrived at by Trial Judge and Judgment cannot be characterized to be a proper judgment of reversal and that judgment got no leg to stand. 

 54. It is well settled that decisions whether affirmance or reversal reached by Appellate Judge are not open to interference by High Court Division in exercise of Revisional jurisdiction contemplated in section 115 of The Code unless it is shown that decisions are founded on misconception or misapplication or misapprehension of law or any misinterpretation of any material document or otherwise those are perverse being contrary to law, evidence and materials on record.
